thread:
maria: Kicking off kubeadm cluster bring-up in nz-south1 (Otago). Goal: GKE-equivalent control plane with kubeadm v1.26, Calico CNI, MetalLB for internal LBs, and an initial GPU nodepool. Posting preflight + join notes here so handoff is clear.

ajay: Copy. Please set cluster-wide MTU=1400 (NZ data center has 9000 on infra but tenant overlay forces lower). We saw flaps last time with default 1500.

devdeploy-bot: Preflight artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/nz-south1/1755300000/preflight.tar.gz

maria: Preflight snippet:
```
[preflight] WARNING SystemVerification: missing sysctl net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables
[preflight] OK Swap: swap is disabled
[preflight] WARNING CRI: containerd cgroup driver=systemd (recommended)
```
Run these on all nodes before join: `modprobe br_netfilter; sysctl -w net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-iptables=1` and ensure `containerd` systemd cgroup unified config present.

taylor: Once nodes join I'll patch the IPMasqAgent ds and Calico ConfigMap. For NZ we prefer VXLan mode (Calico IPIP off, VXLAN=true) because underlying provider blocks IPIP sometimes. Also set `veth_mtu=1400` in calico-config.

kevin-oncall: GPUs: driver required >=525, CUDA 11.8 support. Node labels we agreed: `gpu.type=nvidia-a100`, `gpu.qos=dedicated`. Taint new pool with `gpu=reserved:NoSchedule` until validation passes. Autoscaler: min=0 max=30 for first pool.

ajay: FYI quota: account has 40 GPU quota in nz-south1, requested 80 for full fleet. Plan: create staged nodepools (10, 20) and request quota bump in parallel. If capacity not available, fallback to shared-dedicated pool in au-east (au-syd1) via routing policy.

maria: Plan summary:
- `kubeadm init --control-plane-endpoint="cp.otago.nz-south1.redwood.internal" --kubernetes-version=v1.26.x`
- apply Calico with `veth mtu=1400` and `ipPools` set for vxlan
- apply MetalLB in layer2 mode with internal IP range `10.240.32.0/24` (cloud reserved pool)
- create gpu nodepool with taint + labels, join nodes, run nvidia-driver-installer daemonset
- run validation checklist (below) and then untaint pool

maria: Starting `kubeadm init` now, I'll paste any non-obvious errors.

devops-bot: kubeadm init completed: control-plane joined on 10.240.32.5. kubeconfig uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/nz-south1/1755300000/admin.conf

ajay: After control plane, remember to set `net.bridge.bridge-nf-call-ip6tables=1` too (IPv6 testing later). Also pre-create cloud provider SG rules: allow node <-> control-plane on ports 6443, 10250, VXLAN/UDP 8472 if using VXLAN.

taylor: After workers join I'll apply this ConfigMap patch for calico:
```
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: calico-config
data:
  veth_mtu: "1400"
  ipip: "Never"
  vxlanEnabled: "true"
```
Also patch kube-proxy to iptables-mode for deterministic metrics.

kevin-oncall: Post-boot validation checklist (I'll run this): kube-dns resolvable for pods, calico pod-to-pod latency <20ms, MetalLB announces service IPs, GPUs drivers show via nvidia-smi on one node, node labels/taints correct, autoscaler observed scaling events, billing tags present (`env:prod, region:nz-south1, cost-center:ml`). I'll post results here.

maria: Handoff: @kevin-oncall please run the checklist and mark each item with PASS/FAIL. If any FAIL related to networking or MTU, set nodes to cordon and I'll run debug. Leaving notes in runbook page: https://wiki.internal/redwood/runbooks/nz-south1-otago-bootstrap

kevin-oncall: :thumbsup: Starting validations now, ETA ~30m.

maria: One more note — billing optimization: enable node-level pod eviction of low-priority jobs and set preemptible batch pool in au-east to soak low-cost workloads. We'll discuss post-handoff if quotas force partial region usage.

ajay: Will follow up on quota request and open a ticket to cloud with region ops. Ticket: CLOUD-12892.

maria: thanks team. tagging @eng-infra for visibility :spiral_note_pad:
